own_solution.law: T = exp(-2 kappa a), kappa = sqrt(2 mc^2 (U0 - E)) / (hbar c); a = ln(1/T) / (2 kappa)

defect_reasons.other: T9848/T6F0D phrase 'was then replaced ... for an earlier experiment only' combines 'then' with 'earlier experiment', which reads awkwardly although the intended reading is recoverable.
